text:
Rhea (People Ops): FYI 1: small PTO + travel updates landing today. Highlights: new PTO rollover cap = 10 days, two 2026 "wellness flex" days (manager-approved), and a shortened routine international travel pre-approval window (10 business days). Emergency caregiver stipend pilot (up to $500) goes live as well. Full doc: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-travel-2026.

Omar (Finance): Note: corporate-card receipts will attempt auto-attach via TravelBot for portal bookings. Personal card receipts still need manual upload within 30 days.

Kei (Manager): If someone already had approved PTO around EoFY, is that honored?

Rhea (People Ops): Yes 1: pre-approved PTO before this announcement is grandfathered. DM approvals if you need us to mark exceptions.

Devon (Engineer): Are contractors eligible for wellness flex or the stipend?

Rhea (People Ops): Contractors are excluded from paid wellness flex and the stipend pilot. Managers can work with contractors on unpaid leave options.

TravelBot: Travel portal: visa upload field and high-risk flag added. Commands: `/travel status` `/travel upload <id>` `/travel help`.

Omar (Finance): We'll monitor auto-attach for two weeks; if receipts mis-match, use manual attach with transaction id or ping finance.

Rhea (People Ops): Quick reminder: vendor/event Code of Conduct updated; vendors must register 5 business days before events. See the policy page for details. Office hours tomorrow 10am PT to walk through questions.

Kei (Manager): Thanks 1 passing to my team.

Devon (Engineer): Thanks, will DM my approval screenshot for a pre-booked trip.
